description: This file contains a FastAPI application that demonstrates the use of dependency injection via a custom parameter class, with functions to handle GET requests to retrieve items from a mock database, using query parameters with default values.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A class encapsulating common query parameters such as 'q', 'skip', and 'limit' for filtering and paginating items.

methods.name: CommonQueryParams.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing query parameters with optional values, providing default values for 'skip' and 'limit'.

methods.name: read_items(commons: CommonQueryParams = Depends(CommonQueryParams))
methods.description: Asynchronous handler for GET requests to '/items/', utilizing dependency injection to receive an instance of CommonQueryParams and returning filtered items and query info.
